Deduplicated Orca-style reasoning traces (182k, cleaner than SlimOrca)

stages.name: Socratic SFT
stages.goal: Teach questioning behavior, delay direct answers, scaffold learning

datasets.description: Original Chinese KELE dataset — 6,803 elementary science Socratic dialogues (SocRule framework)
Synthetic Chinese elementary science Socratic dialogues for generalization testing
Multi-turn Socratic math tutoring across 6 student personas (SocraticLM NeurIPS 2024, from GSM8K/MAWPS)
Single-turn Socratic math tutoring responses (SocraticLM NeurIPS 2024)
Chinese primary-school Socratic math tutoring — 6,846 conversations, 513 knowledge points (CIKM '24)
SocraticMATH with solutions prepended in first assistant turn

stages.name: Preference Optimization (DPO / RLAIF)
stages.goal: Teach when to hint, explain, challenge, or reveal — avoid endless questioning
notes: Preferred: asks guiding questions, adapts to student confusion, encourages reasoning
Rejected: dumps final answer immediately, over-explains, ignores learner state

insights: A lot of 'Socratic tutors' fail because they endlessly ask questions, refuse to help, and become frustrating.
The best tutoring models learn when to hint, when to explain, when to challenge, and when to reveal the answer.
The KELE/SocRule work is valuable because it explicitly models these transitions across 5 stages and 34 states.
